description: Tea with Mrs. Grimsby and her gnomes; she hinted the fine could be waived
body: Mrs. Grimsby had me over for tea among her forty gnomes. She hinted the $25 fine goes away if Bartholomew loses a few inches.

description: Trimmed Bartholomew's hat to 2.9 feet; Mrs. Grimsby waived the $25 fine
body: Took two inches off Bartholomew's hat with a hacksaw; he now stands 2.9 feet. Mrs. Grimsby came round with a tape measure and waived the $25 fine.
